### WhiteHorse Finance, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results and Declares Quarterly Distribution of $0.25 Per Share


November 09, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s27.q4cdn.com/509262032/files/doc_news/WhiteHorse-Finance-Inc--Announces-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Results-and-Declares-Quarterly-Distribution-of-0-25-Per-Share-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK


, Nov. 9, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **WhiteHorse Finance, Inc.** ("WhiteHorse Finance" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: WHF) today announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. In addition, the Company's board of directors has declared a distribution of $0.25 per share with respect to the quarter ending December 31, 2026. The distribution will be payable on January 6, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 21, 2026.


Stuart Aronson, WhiteHorse Finance's Chief Executive Officer, commented, "During the third quarter, we continued to execute on the priorities we have previously outlined, including actively managing restructured and underperforming credits and maintaining discipline in new originations. Net asset value per share increased for a second consecutive quarter, driven by favorable portfolio markups. Non-accruals declined following the completion of a restructuring, and there were no new additions to non-accrual during the quarter. Core net investment income increased modestly from the prior quarter, and all of our new originations were first lien loans. We remain focused on realizing value from our equitized positions and redeploying that capital into income-producing investments, while managing risk and investing selectively."


**Recent Developments:**


On November 9, 2026, WhiteHorse Advisers voluntarily agreed to waive and reduce the incentive fee on net investment income from its stated annual rate of 20.00% to 17.50% for the next fiscal quarter ending December 31, 2026.

**Portfolio and Investment Activity**


As of September 30, 2026, the fair value of WhiteHorse Finance's investment portfolio was $569.1 million, compared with $569.2 million as of June 30, 2026. The portfolio as of September 30, 2026 consisted of 125 positions across 64 companies with a weighted average effective yield of 11.0% on income-producing debt investments. The average debt investment size (excluding investments in STRS JV (as defined below)) was $5.2 million with the overall portfolio comprised of approximately 70.7% first lien secured loans, 0.9% second lien secured loans, 0.2% unsecured loans, 7.9% equity and 20.3% in investments in STRS JV. Almost all loans were variable rate investments (primarily indexed to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate) with fixed rate securities representing only 1.4% of loans at fair value. Nearly all performing floating rate investments have interest rate floors.


During the three months ended September 30, 2026, WhiteHorse Finance made investments in two new portfolio companies for a total of $14.8 million, added a total of $6.2 million to existing portfolio companies and net fundings of $0.2 million to revolving loans. Proceeds from sales and repayments totaled approximately $10.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, driven by full realizations from Transervice and PFB equity.


In addition to the transactions discussed above, during the three months ended September 30, 2026, WhiteHorse Finance transferred assets comprised of five portfolio companies, totaling $21.4 million to STRS JV in exchange for a net investment in STRS JV of $7.2 million as well as cash proceeds of $14.2 million.


**Distributions**


The Company's board of directors has declared a distribution of $0.25 per share with respect to the quarter ending December 31, 2026. The distribution will be payable on January 6, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 21, 2026. In addition, on October 14, 2026, the Company declared a special distribution of $0.17 per share, which will be payable on December 10, 2026 to stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026.


On August 10, 2026, the Company declared a distribution of $0.25 per share with respect to the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The distribution was paid on October 5, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 21, 2026.


Distributions are paid from taxable earnings and may include return of capital and/or capital gains. The specific tax characteristics of the distributions will be reported to stockholders on Form 1099-DIV after the end of the calendar year and in the Company's periodic reports filed with the SEC.

**About WhiteHorse Finance, Inc.**


WhiteHorse Finance is a business development company that originates and invests in loans to privately held, lower middle market companies across a broad range of industries. The Company's investment activities are managed by H.I.G. WhiteHorse Advisers, LLC, an affiliate of H.I.G. Capital, LLC, ("H.I.G. Capital"). H.I.G. **SCHEDULE 1**


As a supplement to GAAP financial measures, the Company has provided information relating to core net investment income, which is a non-GAAP measure. This measure is provided in addition to, but not as a substitute for, net investment income determined in accordance with GAAP. The Company's non-GAAP measures may differ from similar measures by other companies, even if similar terms are used to identify such measures. Core net investment income represents net investment income adjusted to exclude the net impact of costs associated with the refinancing of the Company's indebtedness, the accrual of the capital gains incentive fee attributable to net realized and unrealized gains and losses, and excise or other income taxes related to such net realized gains and losses and certain non-recurring expenses that are one-time in nature and are not representative of ongoing expenses incurred during the Company's normal course of business (net of any incentive fee impact). There were no excise or other income taxes related to net realized gains and losses for the quarters ended September 30, 2026, and September 30, 2025.
